[index.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/ancientEuropeBeyondMediterranean/earlyMedievalEasternEurope/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Study early medieval Eastern European polities and links with the Baltic, Black Sea, and Byzantine worlds as a limited chronological exception to the ancient focus.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Şyğys Europanyñ erte ortağasyrlyq memleketterı men sauda bailanystaryn zertte.

##### Kiev Rusı

[kyivanRus.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/ancientEuropeBeyondMediterranean/earlyMedievalEasternEurope/kyivanRus.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Trace the Kyiv-centered polity of the late ninth through thirteenth centuries, princely government, diverse populations, Byzantine relations, Christianization, and river trade, including the Varangians-to-Greeks route. Distinguish evidence from chronicle traditions and later nationalist interpretations.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ortağasyrlyq Kiev Rusınıñ tūrğyndaryn, bileuşılerın jäne sauda joldaryn zertte.

#### Soltüstık jäne Baltyq Europasy

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/ancientEuropeBeyondMediterranean/northernAndBalticEurope/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Rivers and seas connected communities with differing farming, herding, and craft traditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Soltüstık Europa tūrğyndarynyñ su joldary arqyly qalai bailanysqanyn bıl.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Baltyq kärıptasynyñ ejelgı sauda jelılerımen qalai tarağanyn zertte.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Vikingter däuırıne deiıngı Skandinaviia ömırın zertte.

[index.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/historicalInquiry/index.ts)

### Oñtüstık jäne Oñtüstık-Şyğys Aziia

Groups: 4 · Skills: 18

[index.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** From Indus cities to South Asian empires and early Southeast Asian states, the region followed diverse urban, religious, and commercial trajectories.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ejelgı Oñtüstık jäne Oñtüstık-Şyğys Aziia qoğamdaryn zertte.

#### Ejelgı Oñtüstık-Şyğys Aziia

Skills: 6

[index.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/ancientSoutheastAsia/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** River valleys, islands, and ports exchanged ideas with India and China while retaining local traditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Oñtüstık-Şyğys Aziianyñ erte qoğamdary men teñız bailanystaryn zertte.

##### Ündıstanmen mädeni bailanystar

[culturalContactsWithIndia.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/ancientSoutheastAsia/culturalContactsWithIndia.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine local adaptation of scripts, religions, and royal symbols rather than passive copying of Indian models.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jergılıktı qoğamdar Ündıstannan kelgen ideialardy qalai beiımdegenın bıl.

##### Dongşon mädenietı

[dongSonCulture.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/ancientSoutheastAsia/dongSonCulture.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Study Bronze Age craft, rituals, and Red River exchanges, including decorated bronze drums.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qola barabandar Dongşon qauymdary turaly ne aitatynyn bıl.

##### Oñtüstık-Şyğys Aziia araldarynyñ alğaşqy mädenietterı

[earlyIslandSoutheastAsianCultures.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/ancientSoutheastAsia/earlyIslandSoutheastAsianCultures.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine settlements, crafts, and local sea connections in Indonesian and Philippine archipelagos before medieval maritime states.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Keiıngı imperiialarğa deiın araldardağy ömırdı zertte.

##### Oñtüstık-Şyğys Aziianyñ alğaşqy egınşı qauymdary

[earlySoutheastAsianFarming.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/ancientSoutheastAsia/earlySoutheastAsianFarming.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Trace rice cultivation, crafts, and settlement on the Southeast Asian mainland.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Egınşılık erte qauymdardy qalai qalyptastyrğanyn bıl.

##### Oñtüstık-Şyğys Aziianyñ alğaşqy memleketterı

[earlySoutheastAsianStates.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/ancientSoutheastAsia/earlySoutheastAsianStates.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reconstruct centers such as Funan from archaeology and external written accounts.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Öñırdıñ alğaşqy memleketterı qalai qūrylğanyn zertte.

##### Oñtüstık-Şyğys Aziianyñ teñız saudasy

[maritimeTradeOfSoutheastAsia.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/ancientSoutheastAsia/maritimeTradeOfSoutheastAsia.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the roles of straits, monsoon routes, and ports in exchanges of goods and ideas.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Öñırdıñ sauda porttaryn jalğağan teñız joldaryn baqyla.

#### İnd örkenietı

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/indusCivilization/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Indus cities showed planning, crafts, and trade, while political and linguistic questions remain unresolved.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İnd qalalarynyñ erekşelıgı men jūmbaqtaryn bıl.

##### İnd örkenietınıñ qalalary

[citiesOfTheIndusCivilization.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/indusCivilization/citiesOfTheIndusCivilization.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine planning, drainage, and administration at Mohenjo-daro, Harappa, and other settlements.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İnd qalalarynda köşeler men su jüiesı qalai ūiymdasqanyn zertte.

##### İnd şaruaşylyğy

[indusEconomy.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/indusCivilization/indusEconomy.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe farming, manufacturing, and land and maritime trade in the Indus region.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İnd qauymdary tauardy qalai öndırıp, aiyrbastağanyn bıl.

##### İnd belgılerı

[indusSigns.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/indusCivilization/indusSigns.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish surviving inscriptions from deciphered text, acknowledging that the script remains undeciphered.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İnd tañbalary nege älı de oqylmağanyn tüsın.

##### İnd qalalarynyñ özgeruı

[transformationOfIndusCities.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/indusCivilization/transformationOfIndusCities.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze regional settlement changes and competing explanations without claiming a single sudden disappearance.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İnd qalalarynyñ özgeruıne yqtimal tüsındırmelerdı zertte.

#### Dıni jäne ziiatkerlık dästürler

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/religiousAndIntellectualTraditions/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Teachings, texts, and schools evolved over centuries and spread far beyond the subcontinent.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ejelgı Oñtüstık Aziiadağy dıni jäne ziiatkerlık ideialardyñ damuyn zertte.

##### Ejelgı Ündıstannyñ ğylymi mädenietı

[ancientIndianScience.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/religiousAndIntellectualTraditions/ancientIndianScience.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Study early mathematics, medicine, and astronomy while dating individual developments accurately.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ejelgı ündılık ğylym jäne esepteu ideialaryn bıl.

##### Ejelgı Ündıstandağy buddizm

[buddhismInAncientIndia.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/religiousAndIntellectualTraditions/buddhismInAncientIndia.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine the Buddha's historical setting and the growth of Buddhist communities and schools.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Buddizmnıñ ejelgı Ündıstanda qalai paida bolyp, taralğanyn zertte.

##### Ertedegı induistık dästürler

[earlyHinduTraditions.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/religiousAndIntellectualTraditions/earlyHinduTraditions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Trace changing Vedic rituals, philosophy, and practices without inventing one founder.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı dästürlerdıñ alğaşqy induizmge qosqan ülesın bıl.

##### Djainizm

[jainism.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/religiousAndIntellectualTraditions/jainism.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the ethical teachings and monastic traditions associated with Jain teachers.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Djainizm ılımderı men qauymdaryn tany.

#### Ejelgı Ündıstan qoğamdary men memleketterı

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/societiesAndStatesOfAncientIndia/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** After the Vedic period, regional kingdoms and larger empires arose with differing political systems.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ejelgı Ündıstanda memleketter qalai damyğanyn zertte.

##### Gupta patşalyğy

[guptaKingdom.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/societiesAndStatesOfAncientIndia/guptaKingdom.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine northern Indian politics, scholarship, and cultural centers without calling the period a uniform golden age for all.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Gupta däuırınıñ bilıgı, ğylymy men mädenietın tany.

##### Mahadjanapadalar

[mahajanapadas.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/societiesAndStatesOfAncientIndia/mahajanapadas.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Trace major monarchies, republican polities, and renewed urbanization in the Ganges valley.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Gang aimağynda paida bolğan memleketterdı zertte.

##### Mauria imperiiasy

[mauryanEmpire.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/societiesAndStatesOfAncientIndia/mauryanEmpire.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain imperial administration and Ashoka's policies using edicts and other sources.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mauria bilıgı men Aşoka jarlyqtary nenı aşatynyn bıl.

##### Vedalyq qoğamdar

[vedicSocieties.ts](../../../content/history/data/skills/southAndSoutheastAsia/societiesAndStatesOfAncientIndia/vedicSocieties.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine oral traditions, economic activity, and changing social structures in northern India.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Vedalyq Ündıstannyñ halqy men auyzşa dästürlerın bıl.
